articles.summary: Night Of Stand-Up Comedy Benefitting The Garden Of Dreams Foundation With Additional Comedians Celebrity Presenters To Be Announced, Hosted By Steve Schirripa APRIL 13, 2026 - RADIO CITY MUSIC HALL TICKETS ON SALE FRIDAY, FEBRUARY 13 AT 10:00AM Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (NYSE: MSGE ) (“MSG Entertainment”) and the Garden of Dreams Foundation announced today the highly anticipated return of Garden of Laughs, which this year will be making its debut at Radio City Music Hall. Since 2013, this all-star comedy benefit has raised nearly $8.5 million for the Foundation, with the 2024 event raising a record $2M+ – the single largest fundraiser in Garden of Dreams history. The 2026 event, which features comedians Ronny Chieng, Zarna Garg, Josh Johnson, John Oliver, Andrew Schulz and Iliza Shlesinger, and is hosted by Steve Schirripa, will take place on April 13, 2026 at 8:00PM at Radio City Music Hall. articles.summary: Christmas Spectacular Production Achieves Record-Setting Revenues in 92nd Holiday Season Over 1.2 Million Tickets Sold, Marking the Production’s Highest Level of Attendance in 25 Years Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (NYSE: MSGE ) (“MSG Entertainment” or the “Company”) today reported financial results for the fiscal second quarter ended December 31, 2025. The fiscal 2026 second quarter was highlighted by the Christmas Spectacular production’s record-setting run. During its 92 nd holiday season, which ended in January, over 1.2 million tickets were sold across 215 paid performances, marking the highest level of attendance in 25 years and compares to approximately 1.1 million tickets sold across 200 shows last season.
